name: Tsuma Koukan ~Tanin ni Dakareru Tsuma o Souzou Shite~
original_name: 妻交感～他人に抱かれる妻を想像して～
source:
Nobuyuki is a white-collor worker. He got married to Sanae three years ago. She is quiet, but a good wife. They seem to have a happy life.... But there is one thing Nobuyuki concerns. Sanae persistently asks for sex recently. One day, he talks Yuuji, his co-worker, about it. On the next weekend, Nobuyuki and Sanae are invited to Yuuji's house and enjoy having dinner together. A while later, Nobuyuki gets drunk and falls asleep.... Just when he wakes up, he finds Erena, Yuuji's wife, giving him a blowjob. According to Erena, Yuuji and Sanae are having sex in a different room....

translation:
信之是一名白领，与早苗结婚已有三年。早苗性格安静，却是一名贤惠妻子，两人看起来生活幸福…然而，信之有一件烦恼：最近早苗总是反复要求与他做爱。一天，他向同事裕二谈起此事。下个周末，信之与早苗受邀前往裕二家，共进晚餐。不久，信之醉倒并睡了过去…醒来时，他发现裕二的妻子绘莲娜正在为自己口交。据绘莲娜所说，裕二与早苗正在另一个房间做爱…
